name: Investigation Status 1 Code
definition: Provides the status of the investigation response related to a previously sent request.

FOUN.name: Data Found
FOUN.definition: Search for requested data is complete, the data has been found and will be sent using a separate message flow.

NFOU.name: Data Not Found
NFOU.definition: Search for requested data is complete, data not found.

NOAP.name: Not Applicable
NOAP.definition: Search for requested data not complete yet.
